requirement: A language-scoped command must not return record content from or mutate records in another namespace; the global language-name list in context is permitted.

inputs.contents:
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Replacement {
    pub ids: Vec<String>,
    pub replacements: Vec<Entry>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Entry {
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "required_value")]
    pub content: Value,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pinned: bool,
    pub review: Option<Review>,
}

justification: Reviewed scenarios: All exact fetches constrain ID and language; lists select by namespace before filtering. Mixed own/foreign replacement and schedule requests fail before writes, and foreign record bytes/fields remain unchanged. Empty selected context cannot expose foreign pinned or due content.
